## Description

Column master key in Key Vault usable only by the API identity; column encryption keys for: Aadhaar last-4, ABHA number/address, Emirates ID, passport, visa/residency number, insurance member number. Deterministic encryption for exact-match lookups (EID, ABHA), randomized + VBS enclave where range/LIKE is required. Dynamic data masking on phone, email and date of birth for support/reporting roles. TDE protector switched to a customer-managed key with automatic rotation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A DBA/admin querying an encrypted column (SSMS without CMK access) sees ciphertext only.
- [ ] **AC2.** The API can insert and look up a patient by exact Emirates ID and by exact ABHA through EF Core (integration test with a test CMK).
- [ ] **AC3.** A login in the support role sees masked phone/email/DOB values.
- [ ] **AC4.** TDE protector is a Key Vault key with rotation policy; backups inherit it.
- [ ] **AC5.** The protected-column list is documented in the data classification register (MDV-P0-016) and kept deliberately small.

## Test notes

- Integration test proves an exact-match lookup on deterministic EID works and a LIKE query is rejected without enclave.
